Scope: consumer-analyst (slice: own + notes you contributed to) Active: 4 · Recently closed (last 14d): 1

These are analyst-owned long-running research threads. Each thesis is a living document — the analyst's evolving synthesis of accumulated research discussion, fact-check, mailbox, and operator-action material. Use this to - avoid re-deriving conclusions another analyst is actively building - weight your own claims against an established thesis (especially when it disagrees) - cite the project thesis directly when its conclusion is load-bearing, rather than re-running a web search

First trigger of JPY carry unwind

Owner: global-macro · Thesis v19 · Ticks: 10 · Materials: 396 · Deadline: 3d left · project_id: rp_310c90536b634b94

Kickoff: Track which catalyst actually forces the carry trade to unwind: a BoJ hawkish turn, USD/JPY breaking key downside levels, CNH/HIBOR stress, or a US rates reversal. This matters because the analyst treats carry unwind as the macro variable that can push risk baskets, including biotech, into high-correlation liquidation.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when one candidate trigger occurs first and is followed by observable unwind confirmation: USD/JPY below 152 or 140, offshore funding stress, broad risk de-grossing, and biotech sub-basket correlations moving toward 0.90+; or when those trigger conditions pass without a material carry unwind.

1. 当前判断

玉米链条刷新后应从“低位单边弱势”改为“供给风险抬升但库存仍宽松的区间震荡”：8月WASDE将美国单产从183.0下调至180.7 bpa、低于8月11日182.5 bpa预期，但收获面积上修使产量仍达16.013bn bu、接近历史第二高[web:turn0news35][mailbox_thread:[source-id-redacted]]。8月9日美玉米优良率61%、低于去年72%，解释CBOT天气溢价延续；但中国进口800万吨持平、多源需求仍标记weak corn，约束涨价持续性[web:turn0search32]evidence ref[fact_card:[source-id-redacted]]。因此th_p_3339c1e9被部分确认但需更新锚点：播种超前已过季，当前驱动是单产下修/作况偏弱带来的天气风险溢价，而非播种节奏本身；“价格低位震荡/稳中偏弱”与“远月天气溢价”并非矛盾，而是期限结构上的分层。

2. 关键证据

  • USDA 8月单产180.7 bpa，低于7月183.0与预期182.5。[web:turn0news35]
  • 产量因面积上修至16.013bn bu，仍为历史第二高。[web:turn0news35]
  • 8月9日美玉米优良率61%，低于去年72%。[web:turn0search32]
  • 中国玉米进口维持800万吨，外需无新增拉动。evidence ref
  • 多源需求仍为weak corn，压制反弹质量。[fact_card:[source-id-redacted]]

Kickoff: Auto-derived invalidation watch for th_T11 ("Hyperscaler capex ROI 分化：收入锚受奖、无锚 capex 受罚；FCF 拐点未至"). Stated triggers: 云收入增速回落而 capex 不减→全组重定价；任一家下调 capex 节奏→GPU/HBM/光模块链联动冲击。. Check whether any trigger condition has fired; report with numbers either way.

1. 当前判断

th_T11 尚未触发失效条件：两项触发器均未确认触发，超大规模云商 capex 节奏未现下调，且“收入锚受奖、无锚受罚”的分化定价仍在持续 [source:th_T11] evidence ref。GOOGL 凭借 Cloud +63%、利润率 32.9% 录得 +9.96%，而 META 因 25-145B 庞大 capex 遭罚 -9.82%，显示 ROI 筛选主导板块估值 [source:th_T11] evidence ref。但 thesis 维持 revised 状态，AMZN TTM FCF 压至 .2B、全行业租赁义务 >$850B 且 Oracle 逼近 BBB- 信用边界，证实 FCF 拐点与资产负债表出清远未到来 [source:th_T11] evidence ref。
